name: Feedback Settings
description: Windows MDM settings in the Feedback Settings category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Disable the send-a-smile feature
properties.description: This policy disables the Visual Studio send-a-smile feature.

properties.name: Disable the send-a-smile feature (User)
properties.description: This policy disables the Visual Studio send-a-smile feature.

properties.name: Disables external survey links throughout the IDE and installer
properties.description: This policy disables survey links throughout the IDE and installer, i.e. in the preview feature pane, bulletins, info bars with survey links.

properties.name: Disables feedback mechanisms in the IDE and installer
properties.description: This policy disables feedback mechanisms throughout the IDE and installer, i.e. thumbs up or down, the feedback window pop-up, send-a-smile feature, info bars without survey links.

properties.name: Disables send-a-smile's screenshot capability
properties.description: This policy disables the screenshot capability in the send-a-smile feature.

properties.name: Disables send-a-smile's screenshot capability (User)
properties.description: This policy disables the screenshot capability in the send-a-smile feature.
